title: MSFS Marketplace Update (March 7) – C‑130J Super Hercules, B‑25J Mitchell & More!
description:
On March 7, 2026, the Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update brings some seriously exciting additions for PC pilots, with the Captain Sim C‑130J‑30 Super Hercules stealing the spotlight as one of this week’s must‑have aircraft.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Captain Sim: C‑130J‑30 Super Hercules (Iconic military transport with massive presence)
🛫 Arantis Simulations: Daedalus BS214 (Unique and experimental aircraft design)
🛫 Aeroplane Heaven: Mitchell‑B25J (Classic WWII twin‑engine bomber)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 Captain Sim: C‑130J‑30 Livery Pack 1 (Additional military paint schemes)
🎨 Captain Sim: C‑130J‑30 Livery Pack 2 (More variations for the Super Hercules)
🎨 JED Studio: JEDS Airbus A400M Atlas AirForce Liveries (Real‑world air force liveries)
🎨 JED Studio: JEDS Airbus A400M Atlas AirForce Liveries2 (Expanded military selection)
🎨 JED Studio: JEDS Airbus A400M Atlas Liveries (Mixed operational liveries)
🎨 2PILOT: NEW COCKPIT A310 CJ4 CARAVAN BLACK (Dark cockpit textures, currently on sale)
🎨 2PILOT: NEW COCKPIT A320 787 747 DIRTY (Worn cockpit look, currently on sale)

If you enjoy these weekly MSFS Marketplace Updates, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment letting me know which aircraft or livery you’re most excited to fly.

Thanks for watching and supporting the channel 
✈️ See you in the skies!
